dedupe_keys.name: a low cost network architecture enabled by soa based filter less oadms and digital subcarrier multiplexing

description: Napoli, Antonio and colleagues document this resource in the B5G-OPEN community. The evaluated architecture combines semiconductor-optical-amplifier filterless add-drop nodes with digital subcarrier multiplexing. The source reports that its P2MP design covers up to 350 km with more than 9.3 dB OSNR margin in typical BT horseshoe networks. Coverage is the described design evaluation. This result does not establish a deployed 350-km service or an independently downloadable traffic dataset. Related physical experiments may test components under other rates and network configurations. Zenodo provides the descriptive publication with open access; its stated licence is cc-by-4.0. Its publication licence does not establish a code licence or source-code availability. A limitation is that the native metadata do not establish all implementation settings, uncertainty bounds or independent reproducibility. Only descriptive metadata were inspected. Related records and companion papers retain their source-defined roles; they do not imply independent measurements. The design assessment concerns metro optical-network capacity and transmission reach.
